physical_hardware_audit.target_hardware: IBM Heron r2 (156 qubits, heavy-hexagonal lattice)
physical_hardware_audit.recommendation: REJECT physical execution; use classical QCPU simulation
physical_hardware_audit.rationale: Von Neumann entropy is non-linear in the state. 100-shot shadow tomography has standard deviation epsilon ~ sqrt(8/100) = 0.283 bits. Against a physical RT throat depth of Delta S = 0.412 bits, the SNR is only 1.45 sigma. Readout and two-qubit dephasing noise artificially inflate entropy, wiping out the necking signal. Classical QCPU achieves exact, zero-noise diagonalization for $0.00.
